Resort C is four-star, scores 4.4, costs $375, and is beachfront. Resort D is three-star, scores 4.0, costs $265, and needs a 15-minute shuttle to the beach. Which should I prioritize?

Hotel D is $247 with a 4.3 Google score and the right shower, but it will note the arrival time without confirming that the desk remains staffed. All rates are refundable. What should the planner do next?
